0022600206.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-3) visit the Toronto Raptors (5-4) for their 10th game of the season, and Memphis is 4-0 on the road but 2-3 at home, has lost three straight, and sits 7th in the West. Toronto is on a one-game win streak, is 2-1 at home, and is 6th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic. Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), with Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost both games to Toronto in 2025-26, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3.
